assumptions: All encounters use v36 tactics and confirmed replays; completed story, all repeatable sources previously defeated, two continuous cycles without resetting their timers. Each cycle starts/ends at Boris with full mana and the same 6 HP/6 MP/4 warm/4 guard stock; rare loot accumulates separately and still occupies the bag. Analytical working capital 20000 coins permits measurement of loss-making policies; capital is not income and negative returns are unsustainable. Equipment/stock acquisition excluded. Forest collection up to 20min, expedition phase at least 60min (last fight may finish later), real navigation, free world-map transition 5s, trade 3s per item type, craft one potion per 2s. Compare full-mana waits, economical potion use, and drinking before low-mana encounters. Materials reserved for future replenishment rather than sold and bought back. Not an optimal player or observed earnings. Sapphire expectation counted only for successful actions; no lotteries simulated. No daily/coven/duel income.
